title: Traits
description: Every trait a pet can have (src/data/traits.json). See src/game/traits.ts for what each number does.

inheritChance.description: Percent chance a little one gets one of its parents' traits.

idleEvery.description: How often it plays idle moves, times the usual gap (0.5 = twice as often).

happyMs.description: How long it stays happy after play, times the usual.

surprisedMs.description: How long a visitor startles it, times the usual.

poutAfter.description: How soon it pouts when left alone, times the usual.

hungryBelow.description: Added to the stat the hungry face shows below.

sleepyBelow.description: Added to the stat the sleepy face shows below.

sadBelow.description: Added to the stat the sad faces show below.

lovesEverySnack.description: Every food makes it fall in love, not only a craving.

grumpyWhenWoken.description: Pulls a grumpy face when the lights come on.

special.description: Only for characters that list it under 'traits'.
